text: Gold tier customers receive a 10% discount and priority booking on all container shipments.
Platinum tier customers receive a 15% discount, priority booking, and a dedicated support contact.
Standard tier customers receive no discount but get standard-priority booking.
Booking requests must be submitted at least 24 hours before the requested shipment date.
If a booking fails due to no available container slots, offer the customer the next available date within 3 days.
Bookings cancelled more than 48 hours before shipment get a full refund. Cancellations within 48 hours incur a 20% fee.
Q: What happens if I miss the booking cutoff? A: The booking moves automatically to the next available shipment slot; no cancellation is needed.
Q: How do I upgrade my tier? A: Tier upgrades are processed by account services within 2 business days of the request.
Q: Can I cancel after the shipment is loaded? A: No, once a container is loaded the booking cannot be cancelled or refunded.
Cutoff window: the deadline before a shipment date by which a booking request must be submitted, currently 24 hours.
Gold tier: a customer account level granting a 10% shipping discount and priority booking.
Failed booking procedure: 1) Check for slots within 3 days. 2) If none, escalate to the operations team. 3) Notify the customer of the delay and new options.
Booking dispute escalation: unresolved disputes over charges or cancellations are forwarded to the billing team with the booking ID and customer tier.
